en.headline: Firefighter Ho Wai-ho receives posthumous Gold Medal for Bravery at honours ceremony
en.dek: His fiancee and brother accepted the award from Chief Executive John Lee at Government House, two days after the first anniversary of the Tai Po fire that killed 168 people.
body: Senior fireman Ho Wai-ho, who died while responding to the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po last November, was posthumously awarded the Gold Medal for Bravery at the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region honours presentation ceremony on Saturday.

His fiancee Kiki Chan and brother Edward Ho accepted the medal from Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu at Government House. The room applauded for about half a minute, according to reports of the event.
The ceremony, which continues into Sunday and recognises a total of 466 people, comes two days after the first anniversary of the blaze that claimed 168 lives and displaced thousands of residents.

Three people received the Grand Bauhinia Medal, the city's highest honour: Executive Council member and incoming Hospital Authority chairman Chan Kin-por, economist Lawrence Lau, and banker Lam Kwong-siu.
The government has said the award recognised Ho's conspicuous courage, selflessness and bravery in the line of duty during the city's deadliest residential fire in decades.

zh.headline: 消防員何偉豪獲追授金英勇勳章 兄長及未婚妻代領
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超周六在禮賓府頒授勳章，何偉豪未婚妻及兄長代為接受，典禮於大埔火警一周年後兩日舉行。
body: 在去年十一月大埔廣福苑火警中殉職的高級消防員何偉豪，周六在香港特別行政區勳銜頒授典禮上獲追授金英勇勳章。
何偉豪的未婚妻及兄長在禮賓府從行政長官李家超手中接受勳章。據報道，現場鼓掌約半分鐘。
是次典禮持續至周日，合共表彰466人。典禮舉行日期距離造成168人死亡的火警一周年僅兩日。
三人獲頒大紫荊勳章，即本港最高榮譽，包括行政會議成員、即將出任醫院管理局主席的陳健波、經濟學家劉遵義，以及銀行家林廣兆。
政府表示，勳章表彰何偉豪在本港數十年來最嚴重住宅火警中執行職務時展現的顯著勇氣、無私及英勇。
